lines.text: Servant, go prepare the afternoon tea.
Hands off. You break it, you buy it.
I'm off to find a lost Nikke. Care to join me?
Huh, the tea you prepared was terrible, but I always think of it.
Servant, do you want to live with me in the north?
Every machine I touch bites the dust, so it's difficult to contact you.

Are you neglecting me? 
I have to admit, I've never experienced that before.

Humph, should I have this much free time, I could have tea with you.
Would you care to join?
Fancy some afternoon tea in the Clothing Store?
Well, it's certainly warmer than it is up north.
Servant, run off to the store and purchase some clothing for me.
Come to us if you're lost. We'll save you anytime.
Thanks, Servant.
This power to save can alleviate the people's suffering.
Thanks. I'll put it to good use.
Hmm? Is this some kind of bribe?
So you're trying to curry favor with me, is that it?
My affection towards you has been made very clear already.
Sure, I have feelings for you. The question is, can you handle it?
You ought to appreciate me as much as possible. Don't ever forget that.

Servant, if you serve your queen well,
I shall repay you in turn.
Have you got everything under control?
Where's the target location?
Move out.
Enemy incoming!
Servant! Are you ready?
It's time to show them what we're capable of.
You must be honored to be fighting beside me.
Out of ammo.
Once again.
Reload.
Servant!
Now you'll see why they call me The Queen of Snow.
Blizzard!
Behold, my true power!
I've got you now.
You're dismissed.
Ugh.
Uh.
Oops.
This is... tougher than I thought it would be...
You survived yet again. That's something worth celebrating.
